static_traits.name: 林宇成
static_traits.social_status: Has one supportive friend，但not愿与其讨论职业not满；情绪变化与热情下降影响与朋友的互动
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without类似心理问题既往史；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性好、配合度高，能识do not并描述自身思维模式与情绪影响；态度积极，愿意尝试重构与练习

basic_info.main_problem: 我经常觉得自己在职业上应该做得更多，尤其是考虑到我以笔名写言情小说以及曾徒步阿巴拉契亚步道的经历。这种思维模式导致not满意感和自我not足感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些not满感影响了我的情绪和动力，使我难以享受自己的兴趣与工作，因此寻求咨询以改变看法、缓解not满意感并提升动力。
growth_experiences: For a long time has been writing romance novels under a pen name, taking writing as an important interest and commitment, which strengthens the expectation of writing as a potential career direction.
曾完成阿巴拉契亚步道徒步，这一成就体验Reinforcement了对“更具冒险精神的生活方式”的向往，与当前工作形成对比。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于职业上的成功与成就

special_situations.event: At the moment of getting off work after a whole day of heavy work, physically and mentally exhausted
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在还not是成功的Writer或过上更冒险的生活，就说明我失败了、在浪费时间
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Through setting more aggressive career goals and proactively expanding my network, I 'prove myself'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远也成not了Writer/我not该把时间浪费在这份工作上

special_situations.event: When seeing or thinking of peers/others succeeding in a writing career or having a more adventurous lifestyle
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not及他人，就说明I am not good enough、价值更低
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁社会比较，Reinforcement自我要求以缩小差距

special_situations.event: 意识到当前工作与写作/徒步等热情not匹配时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果工作与热情not一致，那么这份工作就have not意义、毫without价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate当前工作的积极面，催促自己尽快转型

special_situations.event: 为转型尝试设定目标和拓展人脉后一段时间仍not yet见明显进展
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果短期看not到成果，就意味着我做not到、not yet来也not会改变
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further intensifies self-criticism and 'should' self-demands, increasing pressure to force change
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 似乎什么都not会改变，我会一直被困在这里

core_conflict.wish: Longs for a life consistent with inner passion and recognized (becoming a more successful creator / a more adventurous person)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被比较中显得not如人，从而被评判为not够好、虚度人生
defense_goal: 用严格的“应该”与社会比较来维持控制感与动力，以回避直面失败与not值得感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、落后于他人的追赶者
object_relations.object_representation: Others/society with harsh evaluation standards, constantly comparing and scrutinizing

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to focus more deeply on inner emotions and sense of self-worth (rather than goals or techniques)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to understand the problem as a 'task' needing more planning and action, rather than an emotional and values conflict (turning emotional distress into a rational task)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以客观、分析性的语气讨论计划与步骤，减少感受词的use，强调目标与效率，淡化脆弱与not安。

manifestations: 在下班后强烈感到当前工作与内在热情not一致，认为“这份工作have not意义”
When comparing with others' success and adventurous lives, the hollow sense of worth intensifies
outcomes: Decreased drive，难以享受写作与徒步

manifestations: 虽有支持性朋友但not愿谈及职业not满，减少了连接与支持的获取
outcomes: 情绪支持not足，易在压力时陷入自我苛责
人际活力下降、热情减退

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁use“应该”句式要求自己在职业上做得更多
Using society's/others' success as an internal judgment standard, ignoring one's own pace and circumstances

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 将注意力集中在自我not足与落后上，Reinforcement自我苛责
对朋友保留职业not满的情绪，not愿表达需求，减少获得支持的机会

Has clear interests and past achievements (writing, hiking) that can serve as resources
能识do not并重构消极思维，愿意练习肯定句与可视化
工作表现Good，具备稳定性与基本效能感
Has one supportive friend可潜在提供情感与实践支持
negative_force: 过度use“应该”与过度概括，形成自我苛责循环
频繁社会比较，忽视自身进展与情境，Reinforcement自卑
对当前工作的积极面与过渡价值进行negate（negate正向）
not愿与朋友讨论困扰，支持系统利用not足

设定目标与拓展人脉后短期内not yet见成效
